thread:
PagerDutyBot: PAGER — auth-proxy egress anomaly on prod: inference-worker-2 sending many HTTPS POSTs to s3.amazonaws.com, error spike and intermittent 200 responses. Pager: P0. (alert id: pd-89321)
Alice: oncall ping — @Ben you're up? can you triage? :rotating_light:
Ben: taking it. grabbing logs now.
Ben: ```sh
kubectl -n infra logs deployment/inference-worker-2 --since=10m | egrep "s3.amazonaws.com|upload" -n
# found repeated POSTs to https://s3.amazonaws.com/collector-uploads
```
Ben: seeing ~180 outbound POSTs in last 7m. Response codes: 403 then occasional 200s. Payloads look like compressed debug bundles. Some payloads contain fragments like session_id=***masked*** and trace_id=abc123.
Carol: i grepped the URL quickly — bucket path includes 'collector-uploads-prod-logs' and looks addressable: https://s3.amazonaws.com/collector-uploads-prod-logs/2024-03-29/
Dave: applying emergency egress deny for inference-worker pods, patching networkpolicy now.
Dave: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-inference
  namespace: infra
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inference-worker
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```
Dave: policy applied, kube-system events show outbound connections dropped.
Ben: confirmation: after deny, outbound drops and POST rate stops. no more 200s.
Erin: tagging legal and security — @Kyla-CISO please advise on customer notification sensitivity. any known PII in payloads?
Ben: quick sample of decoded payload shows JSON with 'session_id' (opaque string), 'model_input' hashed, 'debug_meta' text with partial user-agent. No email addresses seen in 10 samples.
Kyla-CISO: thanks — start customer-impact matrix. Legal wants full list of S3 object keys and timestamps, and whether any provider-managed keys were exfiltrated. Also start rotating any service keys used by inference-worker logging. Assigning to Ben + Dave.
Ben: collecting object key list via s3 API. command: ```sh
aws s3api list-objects --bucket collector-uploads-prod-logs --prefix 2024-03-29 --query 'Contents[].{Key:Key,LastModified:LastModified,Size:Size}'
```
Ben: found ~42 objects uploaded from our IPs between 2049123400-2049123450. Downloading for DPI and scrub.
Dave: initiating key rotation for service principal 'svc-inference-logger' — rotating keys and revoking old creds. ETA ~15m.
Erin: customer comms: hold until we have confirmation of PII absence or presence. If none, send internal incident advisory; if yes, prepare breach notice templates and legal review.
Ben: handoff: I'm due to jump to another pager at 2049123600; Carol will take over detailed forensics. Leaving notes in incident doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/2049123456
Carol: taking over now. continuing list of objects and building forensic timeline. Will coordinate with infra to re-enable egress with strict allowlist for S3 -> approved buckets only.
PagerDutyBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity down to P1 — outbound stopped, keys rotated in progress. Please update incident doc and assign postmortem owner.
Alice: thanks team. assigning postmortem to Erin. ETA for postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.
Carol: adding runbook steps and evidence in doc. cc: @Kyla-CISO for triage notes.
